---
title: "Triple-A explorer"
description: "Swing decisions, contact quality, and pitching profiles for every Triple-A player, with league percentiles and what changed over the final two weeks."
page-layout: full
---

Every {{< meta baseball.season >}} Triple-A hitter and pitcher, ranked against the qualified league pool (150+ PA or batters faced). Percentiles are oriented so **higher is always better**: a low chase rate or a low walk rate shows as a high percentile. Click a column to sort and a name for the full player page. Why the flags lean on swing decisions and velocity: [Two weeks of swing decisions tells you something. Two weeks of results doesn't.](/baseball/two-week-signal/)

```{=html}
<div class="explorer">
  <div class="controls" id="c"></div>
  <div id="flags"></div>
  <div id="scatter" class="plot-host"></div>
  <p class="caption" id="scap"></p>
  <div id="t"><div class="loading">Loading…</div></div>
</div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const S = Sparvi, f = S.fmt, U = S.urlState;
  const [hitters, pitchers, flags, meta] = await Promise.all(["aaa_hitters", "aaa_pitchers", "aaa_flags", "meta"].map(n => S.load(`/data/baseball/${n}.json`)));
  const Q = meta.qualifiers, HIT_MIN = 100;
  const DEF = { side: "hitters", team: "", role: "all" };
  const st = { side: U.get("side", DEF.side), team: U.get("team", DEF.team), role: U.get("role", DEF.role), q: "",
               min: U.get("min") == null ? null : +U.get("min") };  // null = default (100 PA; pitch minimum by role)
  const roleOf = new Map(pitchers.map(d => [d.player_id, d.role]));
  const teams = [...new Set(hitters.map(d => d.team))].sort();
  const c = document.getElementById("c");
  const roleHost = S.el("span", { class: "role-host" });
  function controls() {
    const pitch = st.side === "pitchers";
    c.replaceChildren(...[
      S.el("label", {}, "Players", S.seg([["hitters", "Hitters"], ["pitchers", "Pitchers"]], st.side, v => { st.side = v; st.min = null; controls(); draw(); })),
      S.select("Team", [["", "All 30 clubs"], ...teams.map(t => [t, t])], st.team, v => { st.team = v; draw(); }),
      pitch ? roleHost : null,
      pitch ? S.number("Min. pitches", st.min, 25, v => { st.min = v; draw(); }, st.role === "all" ? "by role" : String(Q.AAA[st.role]))
            : S.number("Min. PA", st.min, 25, v => { st.min = v; draw(); }, String(HIT_MIN)),
      S.search("Find a player", "Name", v => { st.q = v; draw(); })].filter(Boolean));
  }
  const pc = (key, label, fmt, title) => ({ key, label, fmt: (v, r) => fmt(v), heat: "pct", heatVal: r => r[key + "_pctl"], sortVal: r => r[key + "_pctl"], title });
  const hCols = [
    { key: "name", label: "Hitter", align: "l", html: r => S.playerLink(r.player_id, r.name) },
    { key: "team", label: "Team", align: "l" }, { key: "age", label: "Age" }, { key: "pa", label: "PA" },
    pc("xwoba", "xwOBA", f.woba), pc("ev90", "EV90", v => f.num(v), "90th-percentile exit velocity"),
    pc("hard_hit_pct", "Hard-hit", f.pct), pc("chase_pct", "Chase", f.pct), pc("zone_contact_pct", "Z-Contact", f.pct),
    pc("k_pct", "K%", f.pct), pc("bb_pct", "BB%", f.pct),
    { key: "chase_delta", label: "Chase Δ14", fmt: f.pts, title: "Final 14 days vs season, percentage points" },
  ];
  const pCols = [
    { key: "name", label: "Pitcher", align: "l", html: r => S.playerLink(r.player_id, r.name) },
    { key: "team", label: "Team", align: "l" },
    { key: "role", label: "Role", align: "l", title: "SP starter · RP reliever · Swing (see glossary)" },
    { key: "age", label: "Age" }, { key: "pitches", label: "Pitches", fmt: f.int }, { key: "bf", label: "BF" },
    pc("k_pct", "K%", f.pct), pc("bb_pct", "BB%", f.pct), pc("csw_pct", "CSW%", f.pct), pc("whiff_pct", "Whiff%", f.pct),
    pc("hard_hit_pct", "Hard-hit", f.pct), pc("xwoba", "xwOBA", f.woba),
    { key: "fb_velo", label: "FB velo", fmt: v => f.num(v) },
    { key: "fb_velo_delta", label: "Velo Δ14", fmt: v => f.signed(v), title: "Final 14 days vs season, mph" },
  ];
  let tbl, side;
  const host = document.getElementById("scatter");
  function draw() {
    const pitch = st.side === "pitchers";
    const roleOk = d => !pitch || st.role === "all" || d.role === st.role;
    // Everything but the role filter first, so the Swing button knows whether any swingmen remain.
    const pre = pitch
      ? pitchers.filter(d => (!st.team || d.team === st.team) && S.qualifies(Q, "AAA", st.min, d.pitches, d.role))
      : hitters.filter(d => (!st.team || d.team === st.team) && d.pa >= (st.min ?? HIT_MIN));
    if (pitch) roleHost.replaceChildren(S.roleFilter(st.role, v => { st.role = v; st.min = null; controls(); draw(); },
      { swing: pre.filter(d => d.role === "Swing").length }));
    const rows = pre.filter(roleOk);
    const shown = st.q ? rows.filter(d => (d.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(st.q)) : rows;
    if (side !== st.side) { tbl = S.table(document.getElementById("t"), st.side === "hitters" ? hCols : pCols, { sortKey: st.side === "hitters" ? "xwoba" : "k_pct" }); side = st.side; }
    tbl.update(shown);
    U.set({ side: st.side, team: st.team, role: pitch ? st.role : "all", min: st.min }, DEF);
    const fl = flags.filter(d => (pitch ? d.role === "pitcher" && roleOk({ role: roleOf.get(d.player_id) }) : d.role === "hitter")
      && (!st.team || d.team === st.team));
    const fh = document.getElementById("flags");
    if (st.team) {
      fh.replaceChildren(fl.length
        ? S.el("div", { class: "flag-list" }, S.el("strong", {}, `${st.team}: what changed in the final 14 days (through ${meta.as_of})`),
            S.el("ul", { html: fl.map(d => `<li>${S.playerLink(d.player_id, d.name)}: ${[d.flag_discipline, d.flag_contact].filter(Boolean).join("; ")}</li>`).join("") }))
        : S.el("div", { class: "flag-list none" }, `No ${st.side} on ${st.team} crossed a change threshold in the final 14 days.`));
    } else fh.replaceChildren();
    const hi = st.team ? rows.filter(d => d.team === st.team) : (st.q ? shown : []);
    const base = st.side === "hitters" ? hitters.filter(d => d.pa >= meta.min_pa_qualified)
                                       : pitchers.filter(d => d.bf >= meta.min_bf_qualified && roleOk(d));
    const X = st.side === "hitters" ? "chase_pct" : "bb_pct", Y = st.side === "hitters" ? "xwoba" : "k_pct";
    S.plot(host, w => Plot.plot({ ...S.plotDefaults(w), height: 320, grid: true,
      x: { label: st.side === "hitters" ? "Chase rate →" : "Walk rate →", tickFormat: "%" },
      y: { label: st.side === "hitters" ? "↑ xwOBA" : "↑ Strikeout rate", tickFormat: st.side === "hitters" ? ".3f" : "%" },
      marks: [
        Plot.dot(base, { x: X, y: Y, r: 3, fill: "#c9c7c0", fillOpacity: 0.7 }),
        Plot.dot(hi, { x: X, y: Y, r: 5.5, fill: "#eb6834", stroke: "#fff", strokeWidth: 1.2 }),
        hi.length <= 30 ? Plot.text(hi, { x: X, y: Y, text: d => d.name.split(" ").filter(w => !/^(Jr\.?|Sr\.?|II|III|IV)$/.test(w)).slice(-1)[0], dy: -10, fontSize: 10.5 }) : null,
        Plot.tip(base.concat(hi), Plot.pointer({ x: X, y: Y, title: d => `${d.name} (${d.team}${pitch ? `, ${d.role}` : ""})\n${st.side === "hitters" ? `Chase ${f.pct(d.chase_pct)} · xwOBA ${f.woba(d.xwoba)}` : `K ${f.pct(d.k_pct)} · BB ${f.pct(d.bb_pct)}`}` }))] }));
    const who = pitch && st.role !== "all" ? S.ROLES[st.role].toLowerCase() : "pitchers";
    document.getElementById("scap").textContent = (st.side === "hitters"
      ? `Gray: every qualified Triple-A hitter. Lower chase rates go with somewhat better xwOBA (r = ${S.corr(base, X, Y).toFixed(2).replace("-", "−")}), but the spread at any chase rate is wide. Table: ${st.min ?? HIT_MIN}+ PA.`
      : `Gray: every qualified Triple-A ${who === "pitchers" ? "pitcher" : who.replace(/s$/, "")} (${meta.min_bf_qualified}+ BF). Upper left is where you want to be: lots of strikeouts, few walks. Table: ${rows.length} ${who}, ${S.qualifierText(Q, "AAA", st.min, st.role)}.`)
      + (hi.length ? ` Orange: ${st.team || "search matches"}.` : " Pick a team or search a name to highlight players.");
  }
  controls(); draw();
})();
</script>
```

::: {.note}
{{< meta baseball.season >}} regular season through {{< meta baseball.as_of >}}. "Δ14" compares the final 14 days with the full season. Flags fire on chase rate ±5 pts or hard-hit rate ±10 pts (hitters, 30+ recent PA), fastball velocity ±1 mph (pitchers, 10+ recent BF), and walk rate +5 or whiff rate +7 pts (25+ recent BF). Definitions are in the [glossary](/glossary.html).
:::
